context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets carrying raw 1Hz samples from edge devices, bike computers and wearables, with device and ingress timestamps
context_map.boundary_protection: Intake translates device payloads into Telemetry Samples, validates against Sensor Metric Boundaries and orders by Device Timestamp; device-specific formats and ingress time never leak into the model

context_map.direction: Telemetry Stream Intake -> Telemetry Event Ledger
context_map.exchanged_information: Validated samples, validation-failed samples (payload retained) and backfill-reordered samples to be recorded
context_map.boundary_protection: Ledger consumes published validation outcomes only; it never re-validates or reorders, and Intake never reads or mutates stored history. Ledger appends revisions rather than overwriting

context_map.exchanged_information: Windowed validated telemetry and validation outcomes broadcast to downstream analytics streams
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable published event vocabulary with backpressure-aware delivery; consumers cannot reach Intake internals such as reorder window state. Consumer identity is an open question

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Live telemetry ingestion: edge packet received, validated, ordered, broadcast and recorded in the ledger as append-only history
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Immediate within Intake for validation and ordering; eventual for the Ledger recording. Failure to record must not block intake (backpressure applies); recording is retried

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Late packet backfill: delayed packet within the 60s window is reordered by device timestamp and a revision is appended to the ledger
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual; history is temporarily missing the backfilled revision until the Ledger appends it, original records stay unaltered
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Open questions: handling of packets later than 60s (reject or accept as revision) is unspecified; downstream analytics consumers and device identity/session ownership are undefined and may need a separate context. Confidence: medium
